d:
Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has secured a historic fourth term, but the victory faces a challenge from right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro. As Bolsonaro threatens to seek the annulment of the election, questions emerge over Brazil’s political stability, international reactions and the economic challenges facing Lula’s next term.
Thank you for watching our video!
